recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-29320 unless a future work group decision changes where Citation or EvidenceReport should be maintained.
issue_request: FHIR-29320 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request for R5 asking to update the FHIR table of contents and Clinical Reasoning module with a new Evidence and Statistics section and proposed content for Citation, EvidenceReport, Evidence, and related evidence resources.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly naming FHIR-29320 was found. The source history shows the request was applied through related 2021 commits: 0499710536d3cc1a35e0d3410bf373e183460b3b added source/clinicalreasoning-evidence-and-statistics.html and hierarchy placement while adding Citation, and 4edb8d33bcc1dd693ac4dfe0f8ee1c80e7f00fa8 added the Clinical Reasoning module link and EvidenceReport R4B support.
additional_context: The current combined branch includes the Evidence and Statistics page in source/hierarchy.xml and source/clinicalreasoning-module.html. Evidence and EvidenceVariable remain active resources in source/fhir.ini, while Citation and EvidenceReport are no longer active core resources; source/clinicalreasoning-evidence-and-statistics.html explains Citation's move to the EBM IG and EvidenceReport's replacement by an EBM Composition profile. FHIR-53004 later revised the same page for R6 and already has its own reconciliation commit on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current build-scoped source already carries the requested TOC entry, module link, Evidence and Statistics page, and current-resource guidance.
